text: Global Institute of Management & Economic (GIME) at Dongbei University of Finance and Economic (DUFE) offer an BSc in TM (Tourism Management) based on teaching and research, complemented with practical application of learning during internship. This degree seeks to develop active and critical tourism professionals with an international perspective, a sound knowledge of contemporary tourism management theories, methods and practices, awareness of trends/issues in world tourism markets as well the communication, teamwork and organizational skills and competencies to work in management, marketing, planning, consultancy and research. This Tourism Management course is designed especially for overseas students who have an interest in studying tourism in China, which is expected to be the world’s top tourism destination by 2020. The course provides understanding of the tourism business and helps to develop the core skills and capabilities needed to enter a successful career in the tourism industry. This program aims to prepare students for careers requiring global business awareness and to develop skills required to work in internationally operating companies and organizations. It provides the students with many opportunities, both to apply the theoretical knowledge acquired during the modules, and to develop a more in-depth understanding of common problems emerging in an international business environment. It is especially suitable for those students interested in international trade, international business and management, international human resource management and marketing. Duration: 4 years
